title: The Most Comfortable Hammock in the World

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager asks a friend to test the fifth try at the most comfortable hammock ever: lie down and report, or point out the knot.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has decided that (subject.his/her) great work in life will be the most comfortable hammock ever made. Not the strongest. Not the biggest. The most comfortable. (subject.He/she) has tried four weaves and three kinds of fiber, and today (subject.he/she) has finished version five and asks (friend) to test it.

choices.label: Point Out the Knot Under Your Shoulder

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "It's lovely," says (friend), "except for a knot right here." (subject) groans. There's always a knot. (subject.He/she) unpicks the whole end and starts again. Version six will be perfect. (subject.He/she) said that about version five. (subject.He/she) is enjoying every minute of it.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (friend) lies down. (friend.He/she) sways. (friend.He/she) closes (friend.his/her) eyes to concentrate on the comfort. (friend.He/she) wakes up two hours later with no idea where (friend.he/she) is. (subject) is sitting nearby, looking very satisfied. "I'll take that," (subject.he/she) says, "as a yes."
